title: Painfully slow
body: Takes forever to charge my phone. After twenty minutes the pad is hot to the touch.

title: Case problem
body: Does not work with my iPhone in a case. It just blinks amber and nothing happens.

title: Solid
body: Love it. Works well with my Galaxy, charges fast and stays cool.

title: 太慢
body: 充电太慢了，一小时才充了百分之二十，还不如插线。

title: Broke fast
body: Cheap plastic. The cable connector cracked after two weeks of normal use.

title: Warm
body: Gets warm during charging, not hot, but enough that I notice it on the desk.

title: Fan noise
body: There is a constant buzzing noise from the internal fan, very annoying at night.

title: 还行
body: 整体不错，充电稳定，就是比我预期的大一点，占地方。

title: Too big
body: Too big for my nightstand and for this price it is not worth it.

title: 车内不行
body: 夏天车里用一会就烫得不行，然后自动断开充电，得等凉了才能继续。

title: Overpriced
body: Overpriced for what it is. My old ten watt pad was fine and cost a third.

title: Dead coil
body: Stopped working after a month, the coil inside failed and it no longer detects the phone.

title: 很满意
body: 很满意，充电速度快，做工也扎实，值得推荐。

title: Need to remove case
body: Only works if I take my case off, which defeats the whole purpose of a charging pad.

title: 又慢又烫
body: 充电慢还发热，手机摸上去烫手，不太敢放在床头用。

title: Returned
body: Returned it. Waste of money, it charged maybe five percent in half an hour.

title: Faint rattle
body: Works fine but there is a faint rattle when you shake it, feels loose inside.

title: 价格偏高
body: 价格偏贵，功能比较一般，没有宣传里说的那么快。

title: Three hours
body: Slow charging speed, takes about three hours for a full charge from empty.

title: Great
body: Great build quality and fast charging, no complaints after two months.

title: Battery drain
body: My phone actually drained battery while sitting on this thing overnight, so it is basically useless.

title: 接口松
body: Type C 接口很松，碰一下就断电，做工实在不行。
